description.value: Austin Fish & Chips is a fish-and-chips restaurant in Maple Ridge, BC, located along the Lougheed Highway in the Fraser Valley. It offers both dine-in and takeout service, making it a practical roadside stop for cyclists passing through the corridor. The menu centres on classic fish-and-chips fare with a range of food and beverage options.
